info.title: GSellers Seller API v1
info.description:
Snapshot of the public GSellers docs at https://seller.ggsel.com/docs, reconstructed on 2026-11-06 from the Docusaurus build (docusaurus-plugin-openapi-docs 5.2.0). The site is generated from swaggers/swagger-seller.yaml and swaggers/swagger-seller-v2.yaml. Those yaml files are not published. Base URL is the host used by the documentation code samples. V1 does not use the Authorization header. POST /api_sellers/api/apilogin with seller_id, timestamp and sign = SHA256(api_key + timestamp). Other methods take the returned token as the query parameter token.

Seller API V1
